notes: Sections are generated live from the agents' room model: slabs, walls, cores, windows, rooms; diaphragm walls 0.8 m to ≈ −18 m, CFA piles under the tower, groundwater levels 115.5/116.45/117.0; Sejmik hall with tiers, gallery and 1.6 m roof trusses; A-A also cuts WS 5 with its protected gable window.

Façade section 1:50 of the crown: kordon in line with the wing cornice, recessed 'shadow storey', 1.65 × 5.0 m hall window with bird-safe frit, BIPV roof whose surface stays within +36.20…+36.45 (MPZP min 35 m).

Equinox shading: the proposal shades only the square, street and river to the north; every protected window of WS 5 and Maz. 19 keeps 2.2–5.7 h of sun on both equinoxes (requirement ≥ 1.5 h); effect of the project ≤ 0.3 h.

Verification found real defects that are now being revised: garage ramp threshold 0.5 m above the public pavement (→ single 3.5 m lane, gate 4.0 m, threshold at pavement level), 0.30 m cornice projecting over the plot line on street faces (→ no projection, recessed frieze), Sejmik storey programme does not close (→ 'S-2' re-plan with 180 m² mezzanine, 4 seat rows), −1 too close to protected tree roots (→ courtyard strip 7 → 5 m), honest tree balance 36–37/44 instead of 38.
Drawings already follow the corrections where unambiguous (gate, citizen entrance position, granite lintel with inscription, SE corner pier — aligned with the 3D agent).
